payload.text: A PUSH IS DONE when CI is green on the pushed sha (hv, 2026-09-22), and a cut needs CI green on its base first (decision 62, 0223). Baseline: run 40388712863 on 22fcf435, green (Ubuntu, ShellCheck, Test Summary), read in full on 2026-10-27; devbin 0.1.15 was cut on run 40349359447 on a81f0f98. Read every push's run from its jobs, its TAP and its skips against the last green's. A job log GitHub serves with no step names (every line UNKNOWN STEP, as 40388712863's was) is read with CI_READ_ANY_STEP=1 in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/tools/ci-read.sh, never taken as an empty plan.
